manifest.json.interpretation: Exact cases are previously used diagnostic controls; only fresh positions are newly held out. Continuations estimate frozen-policy outcomes, not optimal action values. Fixed-target fitting is not a strength experiment.

replay.interpretation: Game-disjoint for diagnostic fitting only; these rows were available during the original training run.

exact_target_fit.interpretation: Intentional same-example fitting test, not held-out generalization; targets independently improve exact expected win credit.
